title: AI Data Extractor: one item per page or PDF
description: The fields you asked for, extracted from each page or PDF, with the fields that were not stated.

url.title: URL
url.description: The page or PDF link you supplied.

final_url.title: Final URL
final_url.description: Where the page was actually fetched from after redirects.

kind.title: Document type
kind.description: html for a web page, pdf for a PDF file.

page_title.title: Page title
page_title.description: The title of the web page. Empty for a PDF.

data.title: Extracted data
data.description: One entry for each field in your schema, in the order you gave them: the value the page states, or null when it does not state it.

fields_requested.title: Fields requested
fields_requested.description: How many fields your schema asked for.

fields_found.title: Fields found
fields_found.description: How many of those fields have a value on this page. At least 1, because a page that states none of your fields is not returned.

null_fields.title: Fields not stated
null_fields.description: The names of the fields the page does not state; their value in the extracted data is null.

verbatim_fields.title: Fields quoted verbatim
verbatim_fields.description: The names of the fields whose value was found word for word in the page text.

truncated.title: Truncated
truncated.description: True when the document was longer than the reader takes in and only the first part was read. False means all of it was read.

pct_read.title: Share read (%)
pct_read.description: The percentage of the document that was read, from 0 to 100.

fetched_at.title: Fetched at
fetched_at.description: When this actor fetched the data (ISO 8601, UTC).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: One row per URL: the extracted data, how many fields were found, and which were not stated.
